title: Slime mold out-designs the Japanese subway

tellings.quote: If you have slime mold sort of, if you put scat in the shape of the Japanese subway system, the slime mold can figure out a more efficient route than the actual Japanese subway system.

plain: A slime mold, a simple brainless organism that spreads out looking for food, is said to have found better routes than the Japanese subway. A guest named Tero Isokauppila, on an episode about mushrooms, tells Michels that if you lay out its food in the shape of the subway map, the slime mold 'can figure out a more efficient route than the actual Japanese subway system.' He offers it as a sign that very simple life can solve problems in a way that looks like intelligence.
